title: Local Bookstore Turns a New Page
L: PORTVILLE — After thirty years on Bay Street, Chapter One Books is moving to a larger space in the Cannery Market building.
Owner Felix Moreau says the new store will have twice as much floor space, a children's reading corner, and a small café.
"Our customers have been asking for a place to sit and read," Moreau said.
"Now we can finally offer that." The current store will close on August 2, and the new location is scheduled to open on August 16.
To celebrate, the store will host readings by local authors during its opening week.
